::: {#hero-heading}
Hi, I'm Allison! I'm a developmental psychologist and SNF Paideia-Provost Postdoctoral Fellow at the University of Pennsylvania. 

### My research lies at the intersection of psychology and technology.

Specifically, I study how social technologies, like digital media, social robots, and AI chatbots, shape children's and adolescents' development. My current work examines adolescents' AI chatbot use, its links to self-regulation, and AI-literacy interventions that support adaptive use. Previously, as an Impact Fellow at [Children and Screens](https://www.childrenandscreens.com/), I translated research on social technologies into resources for families and policymakers.

My graduate work was funded by the National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship. For info about applying to this fellowship, see [resources](resources.qmd).
:::
